input.name: Post a transfer from a member's savings account
input.description: Looks up a member by ID, opens their record, and posts a transfer of a given amount from their savings account to a specified destination account. Completes the review/confirm flow and returns the transfer reference and posted details. This posts real money movement immediately and cannot be reversed once confirmed.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Numeric member identifier of the sending member

inputs.name: to_account
inputs.description: Destination account number to receive the funds

outputs.name: reference
outputs.description: Transfer reference number issued on the confirmation screen

outputs.name: from_member
outputs.description: Sending member ID and name as shown on the confirmation
